paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R Part Type: Billet aluminium coolant expansion tank kit Part Number: 20-0557

The Radium Engineering Coolant Tank Kit replaces the R35 GT-R's factory plastic coolant expansion tank, which can fail under constant heat cycling. The two-piece tank is CNC-machined from aluminium and anodised, offering better heat conduction and strength suited to racing use.
hl: Billet Aluminium: Two-piece CNC-machined tank, anodised
Compact: Smaller than OEM, freeing engine bay space
Swirl De-Aeration: Internal swirl feature helps remove air
Interconnected Chambers: Cross-over passages at the top and bottom
No Permanent Modifications: Uses existing threaded holes and factory lines
